summary: Discipline and limits support power and transformation. This cooperative pattern asks you to use maturity and depth with awareness.
body: Discipline and limits support power and transformation. This cooperative pattern asks you to use maturity and depth with awareness. Capacity for grueling, sustained, transformative effort. The connection is available when you choose to use it; it works best through deliberate practice. In practice, this can show up through discipline and limits, power and transformation, and the choices you make when fear or control starts running the room.
gift: The gift is maturity, depth, and a more conscious way to work with discipline and limits and power and transformation.
shadow: The shadow is fear, control, and repeating the same pattern without noticing what it is trying to teach.
integration: Let discipline and limits and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Able to carry punishing, transformative work; the risk is harshness.
do: Name how discipline and limits and power and transformation are both involved
Turn maturity and depth into one concrete choice
dont: Ignore the needs of discipline and limits or power and transformation
